summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I checked already (read-only, no code changed) I traced the whole chain end to end before writing this plan, because I wanted the plan to be grounded rather than speculative:  - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — loads via `GET /watchlist`, saves via `POST/DELETE /watchlist/:id` and `/watchlist/:id/items`. No `localStorage`/anonymous fallback anywhere in the client (only the theme toggle uses `localStorage`, unrelated). - `client/src/lib/api.ts` — every request sends `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie always
